entries.name: value
entries.notes: The cases enumerate recognizers, including categories whose general executable construction is not established. Consult each type’s support boundary before using a configured value pattern.

entries.name: value.definitive
entries.notes: References preserve canonical declaration/member identity. A reference must resolve in its owning scope; the value category independently determines permitted use.

entries.name: value.text
entries.notes: Recognizes a Text token. Ordinary source Text and typed scalar/native-byte emission are implemented; preserve literal bytes and distinguish framing escapes from general string escapes.

entries.name: value.number
entries.notes: Recognizes a binary64 Number token, not a %-delimited source literal. Range, finite-value and native encoding boundaries remain stage-specific.

entries.name: value.truth
entries.notes: Recognizes a Truth token loaded from lowercase true/false. This pattern does not introduce ?-delimited source literals or implicit truthiness.

entries.name: value.null
entries.notes: A retained Null token pattern. Ordinary source primitive loading/native scalar emission does not establish a general Null literal; explicit typed definition Null arguments have a narrower contract.

entries.name: value.type
entries.notes: Matches the native type token category. Construction and usable values depend on the explicit source type whitelist, descriptor binding and selected category.

entries.name: value.list
entries.notes: Recognizes List type/storage structure. General runtime element construction, mutation, indexing, iteration and bounds behavior are not established.

entries.name: value.dict
entries.notes: Recognizes Dictionary type/storage structure. Namespace members and imports are demonstrated; arbitrary runtime map operations are not thereby supported.

entries.name: subject

entries.name: subject.type

entries.name: subject.list

entries.name: subject.dict

entries.name: subject.declarative
entries.notes: A quoted name and definitive declarative phrase participate in typed registration/construction.

entries.name: subject.definitional
entries.notes: A quoted name with a definitional Text phrase must satisfy paired framing and typed definition parsing.

entries.name: subject.value
entries.notes: A quoted name and value phrase retain the concrete value category and assignment/definite-assignment boundaries.

entries.name: subject.declaration

entries.name: subject.definitive

entries.name: subject.reference

entries.name: subject.definition

entries.name: subject.directive

entries.name: subject.utilization
